_metadata.description: District-owned properties in the Redwood City School District that are not currently RCSD-operated schools. Includes administrative buildings, leased-out former school sites, charter-hosting former school campuses (Hawes, Fair Oaks), and operational facilities. District school sites are tracked in schools.json; charter schools in charters.json.

sources.districtInventory: TBD — seed data from Board President (2026-04-17); authoritative list pending

Last board-approved renewal surfaced in the board-packet index is 2022-08-24 (consent item 11.8) through 2023-08-31 at $6,020/mo. Lease is current per Board President confirmation 2026-04-20; subsequent renewal document not yet indexed.
